name: Execution-cost decomposition; generation diagnostic, not new benchmark quality
sampler_note: Unchanged original Euler grid: 35 time points and 34 drift/model evaluations
selection: SHA256-ranked original DPG indices; selected before results; calibration/warmup separate
timing: Synchronized wall time: prompt input construction through VAE decode; excludes load/calibration/warmup/hashes/image save. No profiler or module hooks in timing mode.
profiling: CUDA stream intervals, nested exclusive aggregation; separately recorded; do not substitute for uninstrumented time. Cache-predicate CPU durations are not total guard overhead.
correctness: Every arm/mode paired by identical seed and prompt order; record latent,decoded,PNG,RNG equality; any mismatch stops and remains in evidence; no positive-speed gate.
repeat_scope: Independent fresh processes with same seed; uncertainty is timing repeat variation, not quality seed variation.
